info.title: IPTC Photo Metadadata Standard
info.description: This TechReference release is the initial release of the standard version 2025.1, as of 2025-11-03.

altTextAccessibility.description: Enter text describing the appearance of the image from a visual perspective, focusing on details that are relevant to the purpose and meaning of the image

cityName.description: Enter the name of the city pictured in this image

copyrightNotice.description: Enter a Notice on the current owner of the Copyright for this image, such as ©2008 Jane Doe

countryName.description: Enter the name of the country pictured in this image

countryCode.description: Enter the 2 or 3 letter ISO 3166 Country Code of the Country pictured in this image

creatorNames.description: Enter the name of the person that created this image

jobtitle.description: Enter the Job Title of the person listed in the Creator field

creditLine.description: Enter who should be credited when this image is published

dateCreated.description: Enter the Date the image was taken

description.description: Enter a "caption" describing the who, what, and why of what is happening in this image, this might include names of people, and/or their role in the action that is taking place within the image

captionWriter.description: Enter the name of the person(s) involved in writing, editing or correcting the Description, Alt Text (Accessibility), or Extended Description (Accessibility) of the image, separated by commas

extDescrAccessibility.description: Enter the text describing the appearance of an image from a visual perspective, focusing on relevant details that further describe the meaning and purpose of the image

headline.description: Enter a brief publishable synopsis or summary of the contents of the image

instructions.description: Enter information about embargoes, or other restrictions not covered by the Rights Usage field

intellectualGenre.description: Enter a term to describe the nature of the image in terms of its intellectual or journalistic characteristics

jobid.description: Enter a number or identifier needed for workflow control or tracking

keywords.description: Enter any number of keywords, terms or phrases to express the subject and other aspects of the content of the image.

provinceState.description: Enter the name of the province or state pictured in this image

usageTerms.description: Enter instructions on how this image can legally be used

sceneCodes.description: Enter only the 6-digit codes from the IPTC Scene NewsCodes Controlled Vocabulary (see: http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/scene)

source.description: Enter or edit the name of a person or party who has a role in the content supply chain, such as a person or entity from whom you received this image from

subjectCodes.description: Enter only the 8-digit codes from the IPTC Subject NewsCode Controlled Vocabulary (see: http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/subjectcode)

sublocationName.description: Enter the name of the Sublocation pictured in this image

title.description: Enter a short verbal and human readable name for the image, this may be the file name

additionalModelInfo.description: Enter information like ethnicity or other details about the model(s) in this image

aIPromptInformation.description: Enter the information given to the generative AI service as “prompt(s)” in order to generate this image.

aIPromptWriterNam.description: Enter the name of the person who wrote the prompt used for generating this image.

aISystemUsed.description: Enter the name of the AI system and/or the model name used to generate this image.

aISystemVersionUsed.description: Enter the name or number of the version of the AI system used to generate this image.

artworkOrObjects.description: Enter details about artwork or objects shown in this image

externalDocs.description: Artwork or Object in the Image

organisationInImageCodes.description: Enter an identifier for the controlled vocabulary, then a colon, and finally the code from the vocabulary assigned to the organisation shown in this image (e.g. nasdaq:companyA)

externalDocs.description: Code of Organisation Featured in the Image

contributors.description: Enter person(s) or party/parties or organisation(s) having contributed to making the image. An added role helps to refine the kind of contribution.

copyrightOwners.description: Enter the owner or owners of the copyright in the licensed image

aboutCvTerms.description: Enter one or more topics, themes or entities the image is about, each one expressed by a term from a Controlled Vocabulary

digitalImageGuid.description: If an ID already exists, don't change - otherwise enter a globally unique identifier for this digital image

digitalSourceType.description: Select one of the values for identifying the type of the source of the digital image from the controlled vocabulary

embdEncRightsExprs.description: Shows an encoded rights expression. These values cannot be changed by metadata panels

eventId.description: Enter one or more identifiers of the event where this image was taken

eventName.description: Enter the name or description of the event where this image was taken

imageCreators.description: Enter details about the creator or creators of this image

registryEntries.description: Enter IDs for this image and the registry issuing the image ID

suppliers.description: Enter the identifier for the most recent supplier of this image - note that this might not be the creator or owner of the image

imageSupplierImageId.description: Enter the unique identifier created by the image supplier

licensors.description: Enter the person or company that should be contacted for obtaining a license for this image

linkedEncRightsExprs.description: Enter the details of a linked rights expression

locationCreated.description: Enter the details about a location where this image was created

locationsShown.description: Enter the details about a location which is shown in this image

maxAvailHeight.description: Enter the maximum available height in pixels of the original photo from which this photo has been derived by downsizing

maxAvailWidth.description: Enter the maximum available width in pixels of the original photo from which this photo has been derived by downsizing

minorModelAgeDisclosure.description: Enter the age of the youngest model pictured in this image, at the time that this image was made

modelAges.description: Enter the age of the human model(s) at the time this image was made

modelReleaseDocuments.description: Enter an identifier for each Model Release

modelReleaseStatus.description: Select one of the values for summarising the availability and scope of model releases authorising usage of the likenesses of persons appearing in the photograph

organisationInImageNames.description: Enter the name of the organisation which is featured by this image

externalDocs.description: Name of Organisation Featured in the Image

personInImageNames.description: Enter the name of the person shown in this image

personsShown.description: Enter details about person(s) shown in the image. It is not required to list all, just those details which can be recognized

externalDocs.description: Person Shown in the Image with Details

productsShown.description: Enter details about a product shown in the image

propertyReleaseDocuments.description: Enter an identifier for each Property Release

propertyReleaseStatus.description: Select one of the values for summarising the availability and scope of property releases authorising usage of the properties appearing in the photograph

address.description: Enter Address for the person that created this image

city.description: Enter the City for the address of the person that created this image

country.description: Enter the Country name for the address of the person that created this image

emailwork.description: Enter the work Email address(es) for the person that created this image, such as name@domain.com

phonework.description: Enter the work Phone number(s) for the person that created this image, using the international format, such as +1 (123) 456789

postalCode.description: Enter the Postal Code for the address of the person that created this image

region.description: Enter the State for the address of the person that created this image

weburlwork.description: Enter the work Web URL(s) for the person that created this image, such as http://www.domain.com/

artworkOrObjects.description: Enter details about artwork or objects shown in this image

externalDocs.description: Artwork or Object in the Image

circaDateCreated.description: Enter the approximate date or range of dates associated with the creation and production of an artwork or object or its components

contentDescription.description: Describe the content depicted in the artwork or object in free-text

contributionDescription.description: Describe any contributions made to the artwork or object as free-text. Include the type, date and location of contribution, and details about the contributor

copyrightNotice.description: Enter any necessary copyright notice for claiming the intellectual property for artwork or an object in this image

creatorNames.description: Enter the name of the artist who has created artwork or an object in this image

creatorIdentifiers.description:
Enter globally unique identifier(s) for the artist who has created artwork or an object e.g.
issued by an online registry of persons or companies. Enter in the same sequence
as the creator names.

currentCopyrightOwnerIdentifier.description:
Enter a globally unique identifier for the current
copyright owner e.g. issued by an online registry of persons or companies

currentCopyrightOwnerName.description: Enter the name of the current owner of the copyright of the artwork or object

currentLicensorIdentifier.description: Enter a globally unique identifier for the current licensor e.g. issued by an online registry of persons or companies

currentLicensorName.description: Enter the name of the current licensor of the artwork or object

dateCreated.description: Enter the date and optionally the time when the artwork or object in this image was created

physicalDescription.description: Describe the physical characteristics of the artwork or object as free-text, without referring to the subject depicted. Object type, materials-techniques and measurements may be described

source.description: Enter the name of the organisation or body holding and registering the artwork or object in this image for inventory purposes

sourceInventoryNr.description: Enter the inventory number issued by the organisation or body holding and registering the artwork or object in this image

sourceInventoryUrl.description: Enter a reference URL for the metadata record of the inventory maintained by the Source

stylePeriod.description: Enter the style, historical or artistic period, movement, group, or school whose characteristics are represented in the artwork or object

title.description: Enter the verbal and human readable name of the artwork or object in this image

contributors.description: Enter person(s) or party/parties or organisation(s) having contributed to making the image. An added role helps to refine the kind of contribution.

identifiers.description: Enter globally unique identifier(s) of the entity or concept

name.description: Enter the name of the entity or concept

role.description: Enter an identifier for the role the entity has regarding the {...software maker: apply name of metadata property here...} property.

copyrightOwners.description: Enter the owner or owners of the copyright in the licensed image

aboutCvTerms.description: Enter one or more topics, themes or entities the image is about, each one expressed by a term from a Controlled Vocabulary

cvId.description: Enter the globally unique identifier of the Controlled Vocabulary which the term is from

cvTermId.description: Enter the globally unique identifier of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary

cvTermName.description: Enter the name of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary as free-text

cvTermRefinedAbout.description: Optionally enter a refinement of the 'about' relationship of the term with the content of the image. This must be a globally unique identifier from a Controlled Vocabulary

embdEncRightsExprs.description: Shows an encoded rights expression. These values cannot be changed by metadata panels

encRightsExpr.description: Shows an embedded rights expression using a rights expression language which is encoded as a string

rightsExprEncType.description: Shows the encoding type of the rights expression by an IANA Media Type

rightsExprLangId.description: Shows the identifier of the used Rights Expression Language

cvId.description: Enter the globally unique identifier of the Controlled Vocabulary which the term is from

cvTermId.description: Enter the globally unique identifier of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary

cvTermName.description: Enter the name of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary as free-text

cvTermRefinedAbout.description: Optionally enter a refinement of the 'about' relationship of the term with the content of the image. This must be a globally unique identifier from a Controlled Vocabulary

imageCreators.description: Enter details about the creator or creators of this image

registryEntries.description: Enter IDs for this image and the registry issuing the image ID

assetIdentifier.description: Enter the unique identifier created by a registry and applied by the creator of the digital image. This value shall not be changed after being applied.

registryIdentifier.description: Enter the identifier for the registry which issued the corresponding Registry Image ID

role.description: Enter an identifier of the role of this registry entry in the context of other entries.

suppliers.description: Enter the identifier for the most recent supplier of this image - note that this might not be the creator or owner of the image

licensors.description: Enter the person or company that should be contacted for obtaining a license for this image

linkedEncRightsExprs.description: Enter the details of a linked rights expression

linkedRightsExpr.description: Enter the link to a web resource representing an encoded rights expression

rightsExprEncType.description: Enter the encoding type of the rights expression by using an IANA Media Type

rightsExprLangId.description: Enter the identifier of the used Rights Expression Language

locationCreated.description: Enter the details about a location where this image was created

city.description: Enter the name of the City

countryCode.description: Enter the 2 or 3 letter ISO 3166 Country Code of the Country

countryName.description: Enter the name of the Country

identifiers.description: Enter globally unique identifier(s) of the location

name.description: Enter a full name of the location

provinceState.description: Enter the name of the Province or State

sublocation.description: Enter the name of the Sublocation

worldRegion.description: Enter the name of the World Region

characteristics.description: Enter a property or trait of the person by selecting a term from a Controlled Vocabulary

externalDocs.description: Person Shown in the Image with Details

description.description: Describes the person, any actions taken, emotional expressions shown, etc. as free-text

identifiers.description: Enter globally unique identifier(s) for the person, such as those from WikiData or Freebase

name.description: Enter the name of the person

productsShown.description: Enter details about a product shown in the image

description.description: Enter a description of the product as free-text

gtin.description: Enter the 14 digit Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) of the product as defined by GS1

identifiers.description: Enter globally unique identifier(s) for the product, such as those from WikiData

name.description: Enter the name of the product
